<a id="hit_records"></a>
### [`hit_records`](../../../../src/combat/hit_tables.asm#L186) `$C7AC-$C847`

*data*

Hit records, 4 bytes each (39 records). $8832 reads record n at $c7ac+4n. Byte 0: distance mask (ANDed with bit_masks of the distance). Byte 1: new move of the defender, 0 for none. Byte 2: hit_sounds entry (high nibble), energy loss when not 0 (low nibble). Byte 3: hit_sprite_effects entry (high nibble), score_values entry (low nibble). 0 selects none.
The masks have only bits 0-3: only distances 0-3 hit. No hit list uses records 1, 7 and 9.

- **Referred to by:** [`get_hit_record`](hits.md#get_hit_record)

<a id="hit_sounds"></a>
### [`hit_sounds`](../../../../src/combat/hit_tables.asm#L227) `$C848-$C856`

*data*

Sound requests for $dc, $dd and $de, 3 bytes each (5 entries). A zero byte leaves that request.

- **Referred to by:** [`apply_hit_damage`](hits.md#apply_hit_damage)

<a id="hit_sprite_effects"></a>
### [`hit_sprite_effects`](../../../../src/combat/hit_tables.asm#L234) `$C857-$C86B`

*data*

Hit sprite effects, 3 bytes each: sprite animation, Y position, X offset. Entry 0 is not used.

- **Referred to by:** [`spawn_hit_sprite`](hits.md#spawn_hit_sprite)

<a id="score_values"></a>
### [`score_values`](../../../../src/combat/hit_tables.asm#L243) `$C86C-$C884`

*data*
